new_here: walk-forward supervised model that combines 8 known features into one rank forecast
unsupervised market-state clusters used only as the RL state (not as a filter)
RL (offline tabular, contextual-bandit form) that sizes exposure of the supervised portfolio with cost in the reward

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user. No retuning after the result.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0096-0109 U50 (cut-off bar i-2), recomputed at every rebalance and at every training sample day

segments.rebalance: every 7 days on the engine Monday grid (hold = 7); trade at open of day i; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost

walk_forward.sample_days: every 7th day of the engine grid of each segment, starting at the first grid-aligned day with index >= 35
walk_forward.label: for sample day s: cross-sectional centred percentile rank of open[s+7]/open[s]-1 over U50(s)
walk_forward.usable_at_rebalance_i: only samples with s + 7 <= i - 2 (label fully observed before the cut-off). In S2 all S1 samples are also usable (earlier DEV data); nothing from the never-read ranges.
walk_forward.refit: at every rebalance, on all usable samples; flat if fewer than 8 usable sample weeks
walk_forward.features_at_cut: cross-sectional centred percentile ranks over U50 of: r1 (close cut / close cut-1 - 1), r7, r28, vol28 (std of daily close returns cut-27..cut), volume shock ln(mean qv cut-6..cut / mean qv cut-34..cut-7), taker-buy share 7d (sum tbq / sum qv), funding sum 7d (cut-6..cut), MAX28 (largest daily close return cut-27..cut); missing rank -> 0

models.supervised: ridge regression without intercept, beta = (X'X + 10 I)^-1 X'y on stacked (coin, sample) rows; prediction = X_cut beta
models.unsupervised: k-means k=3 (numpy, k-means++ init with seed 0, 100 iterations) on z-scored market state per sample day: U50 equal-weight 7d and 28d return, mean vol28, cross-sectional std of r7; z-score uses usable samples only; clusters relabelled by ascending mean 28d return; refit at every rebalance
models.rl: offline tabular RL with exogenous states (reduces to a contextual bandit, gamma = 0, stated). State = (cluster 0-2, sign of the ML1 portfolio's gross return in the last completed sample week: up/down) = 6 states. Actions = exposure {0, 0.5, 1} of the ML1 portfolio. Reward for sample week s and action a = a x (gross 7d open-to-open return of the walk-forward ML1 portfolio formed at s - 0.0030), i.e. 30bp per week per unit exposure for cost (calibrated full weekly turnover 2 x ~15bp). Q(state, a) = mean reward over usable samples in that state; choose argmax, ties -> smaller exposure; fewer than 4 samples in the state -> 0.5. Gross <= 1 so liquidation is not reachable; stated.

trials.ML1_SUP_U50: long the highest quintile of the ridge prediction, short the lowest (wide_universe_dev.pick, long_top=True)
trials.ML2_COMBO_U50: ML1 weights x RL exposure chosen for the current state (cluster at cut, sign of ML1's last completed sample week)

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0109 (newsrc_engine.flag); DSR N=2 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported.
after_result: Trial count +2 regardless. No variants (other models, features, horizons) in this thread; if nothing passes, report NOT_PROMISING and stop.
